cards.title: Choose Your Return Point
cards.event: You arrived at the starting world as a spectator.
cards.cause: Your first chosen personal return point matters before permanent play begins. Beds later will not move it.
cards.action: Scout a safe place, choose your return point, then finalize your class.
cards.scene: A quiet high view over three possible camp sites, one marked by a small warm beacon; no character silhouettes or interface.

evidence.positive: You arrived at the starting world as a spectator.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Find Recipes in EMI
cards.event: You have had a moment to get your bearings.
cards.cause: EMI shows recipes and uses for the items around you. It is the quickest way to investigate a new material.
cards.action: Open your inventory, focus an item, and inspect its recipe and uses in EMI.
cards.scene: An empty inventory worktable with three unlabelled material fragments connected by fine copper lines to a ghostly finished tool; no letters, numbers, or interface.

evidence.positive: You have had a moment to get your bearings.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Make a First Hand Axe
cards.event: You inspected your first recipe in EMI.
cards.cause: A primitive hand axe gets the first wood before a full tool station exists. Rock, flint, or bone can form the head; hanging roots offer an underground handle route.
cards.action: Use EMI to assemble a hand axe, then gather the wood for Tinkers stations.
cards.scene: Loose rock, flint, bone, a slender handle and hanging roots arranged around an unfinished hand axe on a rough timber stump; no hands or UI.

evidence.positive: You inspected your first recipe in EMI.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Start With Tinkers Tools
cards.event: You made a primitive hand axe.
cards.cause: The hand axe starts wood gathering, while a Part Builder and Tinker Station assemble your first durable mining tool.
cards.action: Use the wood to make those stations, build tool parts, and assemble a pickaxe.
cards.scene: Primitive axe beside a timber Part Builder, separate pick head and handle, and a completed Tinkers pickaxe under soft workshop light.

evidence.positive: You made a primitive hand axe.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Make a Backpack
cards.event: You gathered straw by cutting grass with a knife.
cards.cause: Four straw make canvas, and three straw make string. Eight canvas and one string make a basic backpack.
cards.action: Cut grass with a knife, craft canvas and string, then make a backpack in your crafting grid.
cards.scene: A knife among cut grass, straw woven into canvas and string, and a simple backpack on a parchment workbench.

evidence.positive: The player acquired straw after cutting grass with a knife.
evidence.negative: An unrelated item or another player does not qualify.

cards.title: Earlier Work Leaves Traces
cards.event: You returned to traces of your earlier activity.
cards.cause: Player Traces preserves evidence of movement and work. Returning to a recorded place lets you recognize its history.
cards.action: Open Trace Sight to inspect the traces around you.
cards.scene: An old worked stone path with scattered quarry chips and an abandoned note marker, newer weathering overlaying precise earlier tool marks, no footprints shaped as feet.

evidence.positive: You returned to traces of your earlier activity.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Underground Pressure Builds
cards.event: The underground pressure began to build.
cards.cause: Time spent in caves increases pressure before any encounter warning sounds. Returning to the surface lets it ease.
cards.action: Keep an exit route in mind and retreat to daylight when the pressure rises.
cards.scene: Cave cross-section with subtle dust and fissures gathering below a clear sunlit surface path, the earliest hint of danger.

evidence.positive: The underground pressure began to build.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: An Underground Approach Was Announced
cards.event: A cave encounter announced its approach toward you.
cards.cause: Directional sounds, rumbles, and falling debris warn of an approaching underground encounter. The warning comes from its approach direction.
cards.action: Look toward the sound, find an escape route, and prepare before the attackers arrive.
cards.scene: A dark branching cavern with fresh harmless stone fragments falling from one approaching tunnel, ominous pressure expressed through dust and cracks, no creatures.

evidence.positive: A cave encounter announced its approach toward you.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Hotstone Is Dangerous Ground
cards.event: You approached exposed Hotstone.
cards.cause: Hotstone is hazardous underfoot, even when it looks like ordinary terrain from a distance.
cards.action: Mark a safe path around it before stepping closer.
cards.scene: Glowing hotstone patches breaking through a dark path, heat shimmer and a safe pale route curving around them.

evidence.positive: You approached exposed Hotstone.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Cultivars Can Grow Abroad
cards.event: Your imported cultivar produced a harvest in the Overworld.
cards.cause: Bumblezone is the source of cultivatable food flora, but compatible plants can grow in the Overworld after you bring their seeds home.
cards.action: Keep seeds for replanting and check the plant's growing conditions.
cards.scene: A living honeycomb nursery seed pod beside a flourishing alien food plant in ordinary dark farmland under open sky.

evidence.positive: Your imported cultivar produced a harvest in the Overworld.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Bring Planting Stock Home
cards.event: Wild Overworld vegetables left no planting seed.
cards.cause: Wild produce is food, not dependable planting stock. Bumblezone cultivars provide a seed line that can be replanted after mature uprooting.
cards.action: Find Bumblezone planting stock and establish a farm at home.
cards.scene: Wild overworld vegetable plot yielding roots without seed, contrasted with a luminous Bumblezone seed carried to tended farmland; no hands.

evidence.positive: Wild Overworld vegetables left no planting seed.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Fruit Fuels a Sprint
cards.event: You ate your first fruit.
cards.cause: A varied diet matters: strong fruit nutrition supports sustained sprinting.
cards.action: Pack fruit when you expect a long journey.
cards.scene: Bright fruit arranged beside a winding trail and a gradually brightening amber motion ribbon; no runner or body parts.

evidence.positive: You ate your first fruit.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Vegetables Buffer Exposure
cards.event: You ate your first vegetable.
cards.cause: Strong vegetable nutrition helps protect against temperature swings and knockback.
cards.action: Keep vegetables in your travel food mix.
cards.scene: Root vegetables in a sheltered stone alcove, with cold and heat weather on either side and a stable warm center.

evidence.positive: You ate your first vegetable.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Dry Food for the Journey
cards.event: You picked up food that can be dried.
cards.cause: Dryable food can be prepared for travel before spoilage or cold makes it awkward to use.
cards.action: Check its drying recipe in EMI and prepare a reserve.
cards.scene: Fresh food beside a simple drying rack and compact dried provisions packed for travel; no written labels.

evidence.positive: You picked up food that can be dried.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Frozen Food Cannot Be Eaten
cards.event: The food you tried to eat was frozen.
cards.cause: Frozen food must thaw before it can be eaten. Food retains its thermal state in storage and when matching stacks merge.
cards.action: Warm the food and check its tooltip before trying again.
cards.scene: A loaf and berries sealed inside clear ice on a cold stone pantry shelf, a nearby thawing bowl and melting droplets.

evidence.positive: The food you tried to eat was frozen.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: A Sugar Boost Became a Crash
cards.event: Your sugar boost gave way to a metabolic crash.
cards.cause: Sugar provides a temporary boost, but its associated metabolic debt can outlast it. The crash is a resource state, not an injury.
cards.action: Let the debt recover and check your nutrition before adding more sugar.
cards.scene: A broken open sugar crystal spilling across an exhausted brewing cup, a brief bright amber trail fading to dark blue, no diagrams or UI.

evidence.positive: Your sugar boost gave way to a metabolic crash.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Nutrition Strengthened That Blow
cards.event: Your prepared attack triggered Heavy Blow.
cards.cause: High protein nutrition can strengthen a rested, charged attack. Heavy Blow has a recovery interval before it can trigger again.
cards.action: Maintain protein nutrition and allow the attack to recover before relying on another heavy blow.
cards.scene: A protein-rich provision board beside a heavy hammer striking a stone target, a single strong red shock fracture, no hands or body.

evidence.positive: Your prepared attack triggered Heavy Blow.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Sustained Work Built a Rhythm
cards.event: Your mining sequence reached full Work Rhythm.
cards.cause: High grain nutrition supports a mining rhythm that builds through successive valid breaks. A pause or unsuitable work interrupts the sequence.
cards.action: Keep suitable tools and provisions ready when planning a long mining session.
cards.scene: Five freshly broken rock faces following a regular mining pattern with an unattended pick resting beside grain provisions, parchment-coloured dust.

evidence.positive: Your mining sequence reached full Work Rhythm.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Deep Reserve Activated
cards.event: Your nutritional reserve activated during resource depletion.
cards.cause: High fat nutrition can provide a brief reserve when hunger, thirst, or stamina becomes critically low. The reserve is temporary and needs recovery.
cards.action: Restore the depleted resource and seek a safe place to recover.
cards.scene: A small sealed reserve flask opening beside an almost empty canteen and exhausted provisions, a restrained pale blue protective arc, no characters.

evidence.positive: Your nutritional reserve activated during resource depletion.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Nutrition Cleansed an Effect
cards.event: Your nutrition removed a harmful status effect.
cards.cause: High dairy nutrition can cleanse a finite harmful effect. Status-effect cleansing does not treat Death's Door injuries.
cards.action: Inspect remaining effects and use the Body screen for injuries that need medicine.
cards.scene: A milk jug and a dark contaminated potion with a clear boundary washing away the dark residue, restrained blue-white highlights.

evidence.positive: Your nutrition removed a harmful status effect.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: You Reached Death's Door
cards.event: A hit exhausted your positive HP and left you injured.
cards.cause: Positive HP protects the crossing hit from the injury death roll. At zero HP, further accepted damaging hits can kill. Movement and ordinary controls remain available.
cards.action: Get out of danger, let the healing lock expire, and open your Body screen.
cards.scene: An opened emergency medical kit beside a shattered glass vessel and an intact healing potion on a perilous cave ledge, no body or skull.

evidence.positive: A hit exhausted your positive HP and left you injured.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Ore Chunks Need Separation
cards.event: You extracted your first geological ore chunk.
cards.cause: A chunk is raw deposit material; a String Mesh separates the useful ore before later machines become worthwhile.
cards.action: Build a String Mesh and process the chunk.
cards.scene: Jagged ore-bearing rock above a simple taut string mesh; a few separated mineral grains caught below, with no person or text.

evidence.positive: You extracted your first geological ore chunk.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Maintain a Tinkers Tool
cards.event: Your assembled Tinkers tool is running low.
cards.cause: A worn tool can be repaired and kept in service instead of rebuilt from scratch.
cards.action: Inspect its repair material and restore it before the next expedition.
cards.scene: A chipped Tinkers pickaxe beside matching repair material and a quiet workshop bench, with the restored edge suggested in reflection.

evidence.positive: Your assembled Tinkers tool is running low.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Alloy in the Smeltery
cards.event: You used a Melter or Smeltery.
cards.cause: Tinkers molten metals can combine into alloys in this equipment; Create mixing serves other recipes.
cards.action: Check the available alloy recipe and pour a useful casting.
cards.scene: Small Tinkers melter beside a larger smeltery, two distinct molten streams blending into a single alloy casting.

evidence.positive: You used a Melter or Smeltery.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Molten Ingredients Became an Alloy
cards.event: Your smeltery created alloy from component fluids.
cards.cause: Alloying consumes compatible fluids in specific proportions at a suitable temperature. A tank containing ingredients has not necessarily completed that reaction.
cards.action: Check the alloy recipe and cast the resulting fluid into the form you need.
cards.scene: Two distinct molten metal streams joining in a refractory crucible and leaving as a single different bronze fluid, no workers.

evidence.positive: Your smeltery created alloy from component fluids.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: A Lit Furnace Produces Pollution
cards.event: You opened a furnace that will pollute the air while burning.
cards.cause: A burning furnace releases pollution. A chimney routes the exhaust; it does not erase the emission.
cards.action: Place and route a chimney before running a larger furnace bank.
cards.scene: Lit stone furnace sending a visible smoke stream toward a chimney flue, with dark air above an unvented outlet; no people.

evidence.positive: You opened a furnace before running it.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Escaped Gas Became Pollution
cards.event: Gas from your material escaped into the atmosphere.
cards.cause: Uncontained gas can become native world pollution. Suitable airtight storage prevents escape while its sealed state remains active.
cards.action: Contain gas before storing or moving it, and use native pollution controls for released material.
cards.scene: A cracked open chemical container releasing a dense coloured gas plume into an industrial workshop, a correctly sealed vessel nearby, no figures.

evidence.positive: Gas from your material escaped into the atmosphere.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Disturbing Ore Activated Its Emissions
cards.event: Your disturbance activated a radioactive material form.
cards.cause: Natural hosted radioactive ore can be inert until disturbed. Mined, carried, contained, and replaced forms can continue emitting radiation and heat.
cards.action: Check the material's emission information and plan handling and containment before moving more.
cards.scene: An intact underground uranium-bearing rock bed beside a freshly removed fragment, subtle mineral-green emission around only the disturbed sample.

evidence.positive: Your disturbance activated a radioactive material form.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Radioactive Material Transferred Heat
cards.event: Your thermal system accepted heat from radioactive material.
cards.cause: Radioactive material can release heat into Heat Sync. Heat transfer does not remove the material's other radioactive consequences.
cards.action: Provide a controlled thermal path and manage emissions independently.
cards.scene: A dense mineral sample inside containment feeding heat through a copper thermal link to a reservoir, restrained warm current and mineral-green source.

evidence.positive: Your thermal system accepted heat from radioactive material.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Machine Blocks Open Root Machines
cards.event: You inspected a Millstone or Mechanical Press recipe.
cards.cause: These early Create machines depend on machine blocks and simple power. The recipe view shows the next materials to gather.
cards.action: Gather the machine block materials and make your first root machine.
cards.scene: Millstone and Mechanical Press sketched as physical machines around a central sturdy machine block, with a material trail leading in.

evidence.positive: You inspected a Millstone or Mechanical Press recipe.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Plan Sustained Rotation
cards.event: You placed your first Millstone or Mechanical Press.
cards.cause: A Hand Crank can run the machine now. Sustained water or wind power becomes available after Nether access.
cards.action: Crank the first operation, then plan a later continuous drive.
cards.scene: Hand crank driving a single early machine; a faint longer axle leads toward distant waterwheel and windmill beyond a copper Font.

evidence.positive: You placed your first Millstone or Mechanical Press.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Manual Rotation Completed Work
cards.event: You ran your first Create machine by hand.
cards.cause: The Hand Crank supplies rotational power to connected Create machinery. In this pack it provides the initial rotational source before the Nether.
cards.action: Use the crank to perform the next process shown in EMI or Ponder.
cards.scene: A connected hand crank, shaft and mechanical press with a freshly pressed plate beneath it, entirely unattended, precise mechanical relationships.

evidence.positive: You ran your first Create machine by hand.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Transmission Overloaded the Network
cards.event: Transmission overhead pushed your network beyond its capacity.
cards.cause: Shafts, gears, gearboxes, and belts consume stress capacity. A network that supports the working machines alone can still overload after transmission costs.
cards.action: Shorten or simplify the transmission, reduce speed where useful, or increase available capacity.
cards.scene: A long branching chain of shafts gears and taut belts loading a small drive, with a stalled remote press, no broken machinery or fire.

evidence.positive: Transmission overhead pushed your network beyond its capacity.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Coolant Exchange Restored Safety
cards.event: Coolant exchange brought your exchanger’s heat buffer back into its safe range.
cards.cause: A working coolant exchanger converts fluid and transfers heat out of its buffer. Cooling that exchanger does not prove every connected machine is safe.
cards.action: Keep coolant available and check the temperature of each connected machine.
cards.scene: A red-hot thermal manifold cooling toward copper brown as a visible blue coolant loop carries heat into a reservoir.

evidence.positive: Coolant exchange brought your exchanger’s heat buffer back into its safe range.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Electricity Reached a Consumer
cards.event: You completed your first powered electrical operation.
cards.cause: A working electrical system needs generation, transmission, and a consuming machine. A wire or charged terminal alone does not prove useful delivery.
cards.action: Check the consumer and the connected network when output stops.
cards.scene: A generator wired across ceramic insulators to a working electric motor and fan, a subtle continuous gold electrical path.

evidence.positive: You completed your first powered electrical operation.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: The Assembly Sequence Finished
cards.event: You completed a precision assembly.
cards.cause: Sequenced assembly applies ordered operations to an intermediate and may repeat the sequence. The finished mechanism is produced only at the final result boundary.
cards.action: Follow EMI's sequence and repeat count when automating the next batch.
cards.scene: A compact line of deployers above a belt showing progressively assembled brass mechanisms ending in one complete precise gear module.

evidence.positive: You completed a precision assembly.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Your Work Continued While Away
cards.event: An anchored operation continued outside player loading range.
cards.cause: A supplied chunk anchor can keep its area running without a nearby player. Its ticket kept this operation active while you were away.
cards.action: Maintain the anchor's resource supply and inspect the area it actually keeps loaded.
cards.scene: A luminous grounded arcane anchor surrounded by operating machinery inside a sharply bounded illuminated patch of remote landscape.

evidence.positive: An anchored operation continued outside player loading range.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Ratlantis Starts Logistics
cards.event: You inspected the Courier Lattice or scalable pipe route.
cards.cause: Ratlantis is the next source for logistics equipment as automation outgrows hand delivery.
cards.action: Plan a Ratlantis trip and gather what the route requires.
cards.scene: Simple hand-carried crate transitioning into branching pipes and a Courier Lattice, with dry Ratlantis island stone in the distance.

evidence.positive: You inspected the Courier Lattice or scalable pipe route.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Spirits Are Materials Too
cards.event: You acquired your first spirit.
cards.cause: Spirits are both Malum crafting materials and a currency accepted by some traders.
cards.action: Keep a reserve and inspect both its crafting uses and trade offers.
cards.scene: Small luminous spirit wisps beside a Malum reagent vessel and a trader-scale set of copper trade weights; no figure or text.

evidence.positive: You acquired your first spirit.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Kills Release Trading Spirits
cards.event: You made first contact with a spirit trader.
cards.cause: Some traders accept spirits as currency. Compare their offers before spending the reserve you need for Malum crafting.
cards.action: Check the spirit prices and decide what to keep for crafting.
cards.scene: Small nonfigurative coloured motes condensing above discarded monster carapace beside seven coloured merchant tokens, no faces or ghost figures.

evidence.positive: You made first contact with a spirit trader.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Your Spell Took Effect
cards.event: You cast your first authored spell.
cards.cause: Ars Nouveau spell components determine how the spell reaches its target and what it does there. A saved design must still execute successfully.
cards.action: Inspect the spell's components and test the next change on a suitable target.
cards.scene: A spellbook without writing beside a clear projectile path ending in a transformed block, abstract nonlinguistic magical materials only.

evidence.positive: You cast your first authored spell.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Your Relic Developed Through Use
cards.event: A relic you used crossed a native development boundary.
cards.cause: Relics gain experience through their own working abilities. Development belongs to the same physical relic rather than any item with the same name.
cards.action: Inspect the relic's updated abilities and keep using it where they apply.
cards.scene: An ancient jewel set in a non-anatomical relic housing gaining a new branching crystalline structure, engraved earlier and newly grown layers.

evidence.positive: A relic you used crossed a native development boundary.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Ruinous Flux Resolved Permanently
cards.event: Your confirmed Ruinous Flux application resolved.
cards.cause: Ruinous Flux can permanently mutate a part or destroy it. A surviving mutation locks that part against further mutation.
cards.action: Inspect the actual outcome before deciding how to use the surviving part.
cards.scene: A powerful reagent droplet contacting a metal tool part, one side crystallizing into a transformed structure and loose destroyed fragments beneath, no hand.

evidence.positive: Your confirmed Ruinous Flux application resolved.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Find a Dimensional Font
cards.event: Your first Tinkers tool is assembled.
cards.cause: Dimensional Fonts provide the route out of the Overworld. Traders can sell maps that lead to them.
cards.action: Ask traders about Font maps and prepare for your first departure.
cards.scene: Freshly assembled Tinkers pick in foreground, a folded cartographic map pointing across a barren landscape toward a distant radial copper Font.

evidence.positive: Your first Tinkers tool is assembled.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: A Font Trip Has a Time Budget
cards.event: You approached a Dimensional Font.
cards.cause: A Font journey spends charge and has a return window. It helps to prepare supplies and a destination before entering.
cards.action: Check the available charge, pack essentials, and plan your return.
cards.scene: Radial copper Font in a stone court with a finite amber charge vessel and a clear return path winding home; no portal rectangle.

evidence.positive: You approached a Dimensional Font.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: A Font Transported You
cards.event: A Font successfully transported you into its journey.
cards.cause: The radial Dimensional Font takes you between worlds and anchors the route home while the run remains active.
cards.action: Orient yourself at the destination and keep the return window in mind.
cards.scene: A radial copper Dimensional Font in a circular stone court with a visible outbound path and a smaller returning light on the same axis; no rectangular obsidian frame, purple portal plane, text, person, or UI.

evidence.positive: A Font successfully transported you into its journey.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Vanilla Boats Break Into Parts
cards.event: You boarded a vanilla boat.
cards.cause: Boats in this pack have limited durability; when one breaks, some construction material comes back.
cards.action: Keep replacement material handy before a long crossing.
cards.scene: A plain timber boat crossing rough water, one loosened plank and a compact pile of salvage at shore; no passengers.

evidence.positive: You boarded a vanilla boat.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Your Build Became a Vessel
cards.event: You moved aboard your first vessel.
cards.cause: A physical ship moves its assembled structure through the world. Boarding an unmoving structure alone does not demonstrate transport.
cards.action: Inspect the vessel's controls and plan a safe stopping or landing place.
cards.scene: A complete small timber habitat vessel afloat above a coastline, all architecture moving together, empty decks and no passengers.

evidence.positive: You moved aboard your first vessel.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Ratlantis Continues Below the Islands
cards.event: You arrived in Ratlantis.
cards.cause: The dry islands are a foothold. More of the dimension lies below the water, beyond the first landing.
cards.action: Establish supplies on land, then prepare for a deep dive.
cards.scene: Dry Ratlantis island above a deep blue underwater cutaway with distant submerged ruins and a clear descending route.

evidence.positive: You arrived in Ratlantis.
evidence.negative: A bystander, unrelated item or location, and duplicate same-generation delivery do not qualify.

cards.title: Your Rocket Reached Orbit
cards.event: Your tracked rocket journey arrived in Earth orbit.
cards.cause: A successful launch requires an assembled rocket with suitable propulsion and destination. Reaching orbit is a real journey result, not a readiness estimate.
cards.action: Secure air and a return route, then inspect the nearby orbital resources.
cards.scene: An uncrewed-looking rocket module above the curved planet, lower atmosphere beneath and empty orbital space ahead, no pilot or window figure.

evidence.positive: Your tracked rocket journey arrived in Earth orbit.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: Speed Increased Fuel Consumption
cards.event: Your moving train consumed fuel above its ordinary-speed baseline.
cards.cause: Powered train fuel consumption rises with speed according to the configured scaling curve. Faster travel can consume fuel disproportionately quickly.
cards.action: Reduce speed or provision more fuel for the planned route.
cards.scene: A fast unattended locomotive on a clear railway with a visibly intense firebox and depleted coal bunker, etched speed streaks without text.

evidence.positive: Your moving train consumed fuel above its ordinary-speed baseline.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: The Beetle Built Your Route
cards.event: Your Rail Beetle completed its first route.
cards.cause: The Beetle builds through loaded terrain using its supplied rails, supports, and engine work. The finished railway follows the route it actually constructed.
cards.action: Inspect the completed route and reload supplies before selecting the next section.
cards.scene: A six-tool industrial beetle-shaped rail machine finishing the last rail of a curving cave route, support piles and laid rails visible, no driver.

evidence.positive: Your Rail Beetle completed its first route.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.

cards.title: The World Changed, the Lineage Remained
cards.event: You entered a verified successor of your existing lineage.
cards.cause: The World Condenser replaces a world while designated lineage records continue. Your archive persists and the successor earns a new discovery score. The Condenser currently needs a dedicated server; integrated single-player support is planned.
cards.action: Review the successor conditions and the records that carried forward.
cards.scene: A world condenser enclosing a fading landscape beside a newly forming landscape, one intact archive volume bridging the transition, no figures or words.

evidence.positive: You entered a verified successor of your existing lineage.
evidence.negative: A recipe preview, setup, nearby observer, unrelated output, or duplicate same-generation event does not qualify.
evidence.solo: Dedicated-server lifecycle may be operated alone; integrated single-player lifecycle is future work.
